title: Auth0 Professional to self-hosted Zitadel
summary: Zitadel is a lighter thing to run than Keycloak, and Auth0 Professional is four times the price of Essentials. Both facts move this one.

you_lose: Auth0's operational record on the one service whose outage locks users out of everything else
Attack protection, breached-password detection and bot defence as managed features
you_gain: Pricing that does not move with monthly active users
A Go service with a much smaller operational footprint than a JVM identity server
AGPL-3.0, with multi-tenancy and audit trails in the open-source build

caveats: Everything on the Keycloak page applies here too: identity is the worst system to run badly, and a bad upgrade is a company-wide outage.
Auth0 Professional is priced at up to 500 monthly active users. Above that its cost climbs steeply while Zitadel's does not, so check your own MAU before trusting this comparison.
Twenty hours assumes you have migrated an identity provider before. If you have not, this is not a weekend.
